title: Your Provision has been written for you
body:
Take that which has been written for you. Don't run after everything else, wanting it for yourself. Before Allah
created us, he created our provision. This was 60 000 years ago. Everything was prepared before He sent us
here. No one can get that which is written for someone else. Even if you are sitting around a pot of rice, only
that which has been written for you on the Day of Division will come to you. Not even one grain of that rice
can be taken away from you.
Be happy with that which has been granted to you in your life. Be happy with that which Allah has given to
you. Then you will be blessed. If you are ungrateful, you will not be blessed. Don't look at others what they
eat, or what they waste. Be happy with your own dry bread.
- 01.01.1997
